title: Flatnet
body:
![Flatnet Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4f73681f9354a6a57365effc0b129658c205fd08.png) ‎
[![Subscribe Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0b228d643085497c532f351343e3745b72c24174.png)](https://www.youtube.com/mogswamp/) ‎ ‎ ‎[![Patreon Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6027e3c7e9f2bebcd0937070d6e08165a57622e8.png)](https://patreon.com/mogswamp) ‎ ‎ ‎[![Server Button](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0f870937e610d02b438fca48434fae919e496c15.png)](https://flatnet.gg)
Mogswamp's official superflat server network, **Flatnet**! Explore the oldest survival superflat server in the world, superflat with no structures, or a world that is entirely water. **Flatnet** aims to keep things as vanilla as possible, while adding minimal quality of life tweaks. Join the amazing community and build farms, make towns, explore, or just hang out! Our network has no crates, no voting, and no pay to win ranks. We opperate entirely by donations and via our server's **Patreon** where you can gain access to our Structureless and Waterworld servers. This is a **Java Edition** network that allows all **Bedrock Edition** users to connect and play. ![Flatnet Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d361deaca342ebad26cd7eb50ef72346846d9819.png) ## 🌎 Gamemodes **Flatnet** has several server gamemodes to choose from. Below is more information on how to explore all of them! Use the IP to join the server lobby and use either the compass in your inventory to join, or speak to the server NPC to connect directly. Talk with our Mogswamp NPC if you need help with anything! ‎ ‎ ‎ ### 💚 Superflat Survival Join the oldest superflat server in the world! Going on five years, this server has lots to explore. Enjoy a player run material economy, infrastructure built by hundreds of players, protected claims, events, cosmetic hats, and more. This server is free to play, and only offers an optional donation rank to support the server that provides an in-game rank tag and one cosmetic item. ### 🟫 Structureless Looking for a more difficult superflat survival experience? Look no further than the Structureless superflat server. Grind to get mobs and items, join others on their adventures, and dig a LOT of dirt. This server has optional in-game proximity voice chat. Become a [**Patreon member**](https://patreon.com/mogswamp), [**Twitch subscriber**](https://www.twitch.tv/products/mogswamp), or [**YouTube member**](https://www.youtube.com/mogswamp/join) to join this server. ### 🌊 Waterworld Play on the Waterworld superflat preset. This server is completely underwater, and has tons to explore. Swim through the dangerous waters to gather items, hole up in a trial chamber, or sail the seas and explore on this superflat preset! This server has optional in-game proximity voice chat. Become a [**Patreon member**](https://patreon.com/mogswamp), [**Twitch subscriber**](https://www.twitch.tv/products/mogswamp), or [**YouTube member**](https://www.youtube.com/mogswamp/join) to join this server. ![Flatnet Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d361deaca342ebad26cd7eb50ef72346846d9819.png) ## ✨ Server Features **Flatnet** is mostly vanilla, but here is some more information on what our network has.
SERVER FEATURES | **FEATURE** | **SUPERFLAT** | **STRUCTURELESS** | **WATERWORLD** | |:--------------------|:----------------------|:----------------------|:----------------------| |**FREE**|✅|❌|❌| |**COSMETICS**|✅|❌|❌| |**CLAIMS**|✅|✅|✅| |**STARTER KIT**|✅|✅|✅| |**HOMES**|⚠️|✅|✅| |**SERVER WARPS**|✅|✅|✅| |**SITTING ON BLOCKS**|✅|✅|✅| |**`/help` COMMAND**|✅|✅|✅| |**`/profile` COMMAND**|✅|✅|✅| |**RANDOM TP**|✅|✅|✅| |**PLAYER TP**|❌|✅|✅| |**VOICE CHAT MOD**|❌|✅|✅| |**SERVER MAP**|❌|✅|✅| ⚠️ Right-click a bed to set your respawn point and use `/home` to get back. Use `/sethome` on our other servers. 👑 Become a [**Patreon member**](https://patreon.com/mogswamp), [**Twitch subscriber**](https://www.twitch.tv/products/mogswamp), or [**YouTube member**](https://www.youtube.com/mogswamp/join) to join Structureless and Waterworld. Join the lobby, connect to the server, and follow the on screen instructions for how to join. You MUST be a member of our [**Discord**](https://discord.gg/mogswamp) to be able to join. 🌎 View our server maps: - [Structureless Map](http://45.59.171.40:8200/) - [Waterworld Map](http://45.59.171.40:8300/) 📢 Download [**Simple Voice Chat Mod**](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat/versions?g=1.21.8) to chat with players in game.
OPTIONAL RESOURCE PACKS Big thanks to those who maintain these resource packs for our server. - [Flatnet Server Resource Pack - Java Edition](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/flatnet-server-resource-pack-java) - [Flatnet As Mobs](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/flatnet-as-mobs)
![Flatnet Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d361deaca342ebad26cd7eb50ef72346846d9819.png) ## 📞 SUPPORT **For Help or Issues**: 1. Ensure you have the correct IP. 2. Make sure you are joining on a supported version. 3. Contact support via our Discord: **https://discord.gg/mogswamp** To appeal a ban, or if you do not have Discord to reach out for support, email us at **support@flatnet.gg**. ![Flatnet Divider](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d361deaca342ebad26cd7eb50ef72346846d9819.png) **Never played superflat survival before? Don't worry, check out this video on how to get started!** ---
